We need an engineer to deploy a copy of this system on our sever. text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a hard-working developer who’s passionate about building reliable web and app experiences.

I have 7 years of experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, and full-stack development. I can help deploy a self-managed Open edX setup on your server and customize the Android and iOS apps with your company brand, name, and logo.

One relevant project was Tutor marketplace MVP for Brightpath Tutors, where I built a two-sided edtech marketplace with tutor profiles, booking, video lessons, and automatic tutor payouts. It went live in 11 weeks.

I’m comfortable working with existing codebases and can focus on clean customization and a smooth deployment path. Are you planning to use the standard Open edX self-managed installation or Tutor for the server setup?
